content: HA tuya sensor.py: wsdcg uses va_temperature/temp_current (TEMPERATURE), va_humidity/humidity_value (HUMIDITY), plus BATTERY_SENSORS (battery_percentage, battery_state). binary_sensor.py: mcs->doorcontact_state (DOOR, on=True), pir->pir (MOTION, on='pir'), sj->watersensor_state (MOISTURE, on={'1','alarm'}), ywbj->smoke_sensor_status (SMOKE, on='alarm'), rqbj->gas_sensor_status (GAS). All add temper_alarm (TAMPER). Integer sensors scaled via scale_value = raw/(10**scale).
